scope: Synthetic fixture labels only, never owner feedback

checks.name: Cold model has two inactive channels and zero adjustment
Both/Neither activate a separate acceptability model without A/B votes
Every same-outfit/context absolute label counts once despite repeat exposure
A/B responses never imply acceptable winner or unacceptable loser
Old eight-informative/three-group A/B guard is not lowered
Both/Neither cannot change directional coefficients
A/B feedback cannot change the separate acceptance fit
One acceptance class alone never activates acceptability
Insufficient labels or single-group evidence does not activate acceptability
Contradictory complete-outfit acceptance labels are quarantined, not averaged
Repeated or reversed comparisons do not increase fitted data counts
Reserved A/B and acceptance feedback never affect either fit
Even direct fit protects reserved topwear tagged incorrectly as training
Import/add rejects reserved topwear reassigned to training
Reasons are preserved but never guessed or translated into extra labels
S02 remains excluded from both fits and from saving new votes
Existing v1 feedback schema/source/IDs survive a read-only refit
Import is a preview/merge; it does not replace original answers or wear/Favorites
Pause stops both learned effects without dropping answers; resume restores fits
Undo last exact response recomputes only the local preference model
Corrupt/stale storage remains blocked, not emptied or overwritten
Opposite acceptability labels reverse the fitted signal, without ID bonuses
Combined adjustment is bounded; acceptance-only uses at most0.20
Complete result discloses both active channels and their contributions
Analytical two-channel bound safely covers clothing plus all shoes
Malformed model status and tampered limits are rejected
Twelve new pairs are source-eligible, with six shirt and six complete-look comparisons
New comparison bank has no repeated old pair, answer, model score or S02 image
Reserved new groups are still reserved under import and core fitting
Original directional coefficients/math remain equal to V1.22.1
